rosa: docs/error-reference/429-behavior.md under 'examples'. I'm proposing a rewrite to: prefer server Retry-After, then our X-Redwood-Backoff hint, then exp+jitter. Also show a "context-salvage" fallback (trim non-essential messages) instead of retrying endlessly.

nina: love context-salvage idea — we should show a tiny Node example that tries trim -> small-model -> backoff. Keep it <20 lines.

rosa: suggested Node snippet (pseudocode):

```
// prefer Retry-After -> X-Redwood-Backoff -> exp+jitter
for (let attempt=1; attempt<=5; attempt++) {
  const r = await client.generate(req)
  if (r.ok) return r
  let hint = r.headers.get('Retry-After') || r.headers.get('X-Redwood-Backoff')
  if (!hint) hint = Math.min(30, Math.pow(2, attempt)) * (0.8 + Math.random()*0.4)
  await sleep(Math.max(1, parseFloat(hint)))
  if (attempt==3) { req = salvageContext(req) } // drop non-essential history
}
throw new Error('circuit open')
```

nina: nice. For curl one-liner (annotate):
```
# brittle dev check only
sleep $(curl -sI -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.com/v1/respond | grep -i Retry-After | awk '{print $2}')
```

devon: add guidance: normalize Retry-After < 1s to 1s, jitter +/-30%, cap retries and open circuit. Also call out streaming case: if a stream fails with 429, reconnect with backoff and replay only minimal resume tokens.
